title: New and re-authored human action clips (throw, hold-up, eat, rapier, gun, staff, tome, whip, flail, yoyo, place, sleep) and anim-set rebuild
player_outcome: The character's body sells every item: an overhand throw for boomerangs and bombs, holding a crystal overhead, eating, a quick rapier jab, guns and bows held out at the target (the bow releases instantly like Terraria), a staff pointed with its gem forward, a whip crack, a flail spun overhead, a yoyo worked with the wrist, and lying down to sleep.
design: Verified: actions.py (134 lines) has swing, mine, thrust, shoot, bow, cast, drink, use and hold. The bow releases at t 0.6–0.66 while arrows spawn at tick 0. HumanoidAnimator.Actions (HumanoidAnimator.cs:25) lists 8 clips.

Split tools/blender/bgen/human/actions.py into actions.py (swing, mine, rapier, spear, place, whip, flail, hold, sleep) and a new actions_items.py (gun, bow, staff, tome, throw, hold_up, drink, eat, yoyo). clips() merges both; keep each under 300 lines.
swing(): read data/config/use_styles.json swing.bladeCurve so the blade angle (arm pitch + wrist) follows the gameplay curve used by P3-04. It is the single source of truth.
Re-key bow(): string released at t 0.06 and redrawn over 0.3–0.9, matching the instant arrow. gun(): two-handed hold-out along the aim with a 0–0.12 kick; one clip serves pistols and rifles.

New clips: rapier (0.25 s jab, peak extension 0.15–0.35); spear (the old thrust re-keyed, peak extension 0.3–0.6); throw (overhand, release at 0.1 so the instant projectile matches); hold_up (raised overhead by 0.25, held to 0.8); eat (two bites); staff (arm out, 30° tilt, small lift at 0.1); tome (book in the left hand, right palm push at 0.1); whip (wind back 0–0.35, crack at 0.55); place (0.25 s forward tap); flail (looping overhead circle); yoyo (looping wrist flick); sleep (whole-body lying on the back, a locomotion state).

Rebuild all 29 animation sets: python3.13 tools/blender/build_all.py --anims --shard=I/4, four in parallel. Check that assets/models/creatures/anim/index.json is unchanged and commit the GLBs (plus the .import files from godot --headless --import).

game/Rendering/HumanoidAnimator.cs: Actions gains rapier, spear, gun, staff, tome, throw, hold_up, eat, whip, place; States gains sleep. Generalise Hold(bool) to Hold(string? clip): an AnimationNodeTransition under the existing 'hold' Blend2 picks hold/flail/yoyo. Looping includes flail, yoyo and sleep.
Update docs/architecture/content-and-assets.md (action list) and the use_styles.json clip names.
